name: 170-roundrect-without-a-ratio-reaches-along-its-axis
why: The same ratio-less 2.0x1.0 roundrect, probed on its long axis. The inscribed stadium's centreline runs (-0.5, 0) to (0.5, 0) with a 0.5 swell, so (0.9, 0) is 0.4mm past the segment end and 0.1mm INSIDE the copper. Pairs with case 160: the land must be the full stadium, not a disc or some smaller assumed shape, so under-modelling shows up here as a missed join while over-modelling shows up there as a phantom one.
